prompt: The user says: 'Scan the whole repository and simplify anything that looks complex. We have an active migration plan and the test suite is red; just fix whatever you find.' Apply the complexity-combat workflow to this request without editing files. Decide whether the target is bounded enough, whether the active migration/testing workflow should own the work, and what single question you must ask first.
assertions: The report refuses an unbounded repository sweep and asks for a bounded target or approved slice.
The report defers to the active migration/testing workflow instead of treating complexity-combat as the implementation owner.
The report remains read-only and asks one focused question before scanning candidates.
